reason: A conversation-integrated visualization plugin that runs read-only Git queries and renders interactive commit graphs and commit diffs.

summaries.zh: 在会话中执行只读 Git 查询，并以交互式卡片展示提交图、提交详情和文件差异。
summaries.en: Runs read-only Git queries in a conversation and presents interactive cards for commit graphs, commit details, and file diffs.

capabilities: Executes read-only git commands in a session working directory or specified repository
Displays commit DAGs, branch and tag references, commit metadata, file status, and diffs in interactive conversation cards
